hooks.command: jq -n --arg c 'AGENTS.md is this project memory, and the task guides under .claude/skills/ are its on-demand chapters. Per AGENTS.md section 10 (Lessons learned): whenever you discover and fix a non-obvious mistake - an unknown CI or linter rule, a framework quirk, a wrong assumption you had to unlearn, a tool that behaved destructively - record the rule back in the SAME change, before you finish. Route it where the next agent will hit it: a step-specific lesson goes into that step guide (.claude/skills/port-a-sample, e2e-debugging, regenerate-artefacts, run-the-gates, scaffold-a-port, idiom-lookup); only a cross-cutting one goes into AGENTS.md section 10 or 8 - never grow AGENTS.md with step-specific material. Write the rule, not the story, and name the app or class where it bit us. Ask yourself at the end of the task: did I learn something the next agent would otherwise repeat?' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$c}}'
